mapper.sql: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM internal_notice_attachment WHERE stored_file_id = stored_file.stored_file_id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM resource_file WHERE stored_file_id = stored_file.stored_file_id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM activity_record_file WHERE stored_file_id = stored_file.stored_file_id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset_item WHERE photo_file_id = stored_file.stored_file_id )
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO public_notice_retirement_manifest ( stored_file_id, storage_scope_code, storage_key, retirement_status_code, processed_dttm ) SELECT stored_file.stored_file_id, stored_file.storage_scope_code, stored_file.storage_key, CASE WHEN THEN 'RETAINED_SHARED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, CASE WHEN THEN NOW(6) ELSE NULL END FROM public_notice_attachment JOIN stored_file ON stored_file.stored_file_id = public_notice_attachment.stored_file_id GROUP BY stored_file.stored_file_id, stored_file.storage_scope_code, stored_file.storage_key
mapper.update: UPDATE public_notice_retirement_manifest AS manifest JOIN stored_file ON stored_file.stored_file_id = manifest.stored_file_id SET manifest.retirement_status_code = 'RETAINED_SHARED', manifest.failure_reason = NULL, manifest.processed_dttm = COALESCE(manifest.processed_dttm, NOW(6)) WHERE manifest.retirement_status_code IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND ()
mapper.select: SELECT public_notice_retirement_manifest_id, stored_file_id, storage_scope_code, storage_key, retirement_status_code, failure_reason, created_dttm, processed_dttm FROM public_notice_retirement_manifest WHERE retirement_status_code = 'PENDING' ORDER BY public_notice_retirement_manifest_id

SELECT public_notice_retirement_manifest_id, stored_file_id, storage_scope_code, storage_key, retirement_status_code, failure_reason, created_dttm, processed_dttm FROM public_notice_retirement_manifest ORDER BY public_notice_retirement_manifest_id
mapper.update: UPDATE public_notice_retirement_manifest SET retirement_status_code = 'DELETED', failure_reason = NULL, processed_dttm = NOW(6) WHERE public_notice_retirement_manifest_id = #{publicNoticeRetirementManifestId} AND retirement_status_code = 'PENDING'

UPDATE public_notice_retirement_manifest SET retirement_status_code = 'FAILED', failure_reason = #{failureReason}, processed_dttm = NOW(6) WHERE public_notice_retirement_manifest_id = #{publicNoticeRetirementManifestId} AND retirement_status_code = 'PENDING'
